notes: DECISION: SwarmSync publishes its mark only as rasters. The current swarmsyncai.svg is swarmsync.ai/favicon.svg, an SVG wrapping a 64x64 PNG (fails rule 2 and is tiny). Every larger official icon (android-chrome 512 and 192, apple-touch 180) sets the sigil on the site's near-black #05060B square, the manifest's background_color, which is SwarmSync's own app-icon tile; on the dark theme the tile merges with the surface, on the light theme it shows as a black square. If the reviewer prefers the bare sigil, the only transparent copy is the 64px PNG inside favicon.svg. No SVG qualifies: favicon.svg wraps a PNG; header logos are WebP (/logos/swarmsync-horizontal.webp, swarmsync-stacked.webp, mark plus wordmark); n8n-nodes-swarmsync ships a generic purple three-dot tile, not the logo.
